name: Three-stage methane liquefaction (fully-specified)
description: Construct a once-through methane liquefaction flowsheet using NRTL. Feed 1.0 kg/h of pure methane vapour (0.0173 mol/s) at 280.0 K and 1 bar to a first compressor with a 5 bar discharge pressure, then cool the gas back to 280.0 K. Send it to a second compressor with a 25 bar discharge pressure and cool it back to 280.0 K again. Compress the gas in a third compressor to 100 bar, then cool the high-pressure stream to 210.0 K in a cryogenic cooler. Expand this stream through an expander to 1 bar so that it becomes two phase, and feed the expander outlet to a gas-liquid separator. Withdraw liquid methane from the separator bottom and unliquefied methane vapour from the top as separate products. The sequence is exactly three compressors, three coolers, one expander, and one gas-liquid separator. There is no recycle.
notes: Fully-specified variant of VAL_01, constructed to isolate construction-at-scale (building the 3-stage compress + intercool + expand + separate topology) from design inference (guessing unstated conditions) — VAL_01 leaves every operating condition unstated. Same flowsheet and same reference (benchmark/reference_flowsheets/VAL_01_reference.json), which is NOT modified. Every value in the description was read from that reference: feed 279.95 K / 1 bar / 0.0173 mol/s (S-01); three compression stages to 5/25/100 bar (K-01/02/03 P_out = 5e5/2.5e6/1e7 Pa); intercoolers after stages 1 and 2 to 279.95 K (CO-01/02 T_out); cryogenic cooler to 210 K (CO-03 T_out); expander outlet 1 bar (EX-01 P_out); separator vapour product S-09 (vapor_fraction=1.0), liquid product S-10 (vapor_fraction=0.0). Additional reference facts NOT stated as conditions: (a) feed flow 0.0173 mol/s is extensive and does not enter the intensive T/P/vf reference-MAPE; (b) compressor discharge temperatures on K-01 (400.58 K) and K-03 (389.24 K) are captured OUTPUTS of P_out + efficiency, not design inputs (K-02 has none), so they are not stated — stating them would over-specify; (c) the reference additionally carries 8 regenerative heat exchangers (HT-01..08) that the process narrative does not describe, so the described chain is 8 units mapping onto the reference's 10-stream main path S-01..S-10. The reference cryo cooler reaches only 210 K (-63 C); the expander does the liquefaction to 111.47 K — the description states 210 K explicitly rather than the vague 'cryogenic'. Description corrected post-audit to match verified source topology (Methane_Liquefaction_Cycle.dwxmz, connections confirmed once-through); the original phrasing implied a Linde-cycle recycle not present in the FOSSEE flowsheet.

name: Hydrodealkylation Toluene to Benzene (fully-specified)
description: Construct a toluene hydrodealkylation flowsheet using the SRK property package. Feed liquid toluene at 373.15 K and 2 bar and a separate hydrogen stream to a feed mixer. The source does not report the hydrogen feed temperature, pressure, or flow, so infer physically suitable values. Heat the mixed feed to 873.15 K, then send it to a conversion reactor operating at 873.15 K and 23.5 bar. Apply 90.02% per-pass conversion of toluene using the reaction Toluene + Hydrogen -> Benzene + Methane. Cool the reactor effluent to 353.15 K and send it to a vapour-liquid separator. Recycle the hydrogen- and methane-rich vapour outlet directly to the feed mixer. Heat the separator liquid outlet to 375.15 K and feed it to a distillation column. Withdraw a benzene-rich distillate as product. Send the toluene-rich column bottoms through a pump and recycle it to the same feed mixer. The required main sequence is mixer, feed heater, conversion reactor, effluent cooler, vapour-liquid separator, liquid reheater, distillation column, and bottoms pump, with separate vapour and bottoms recycle loops.
notes: Fully-specified variant of VAL_03. Values read from benchmark/reference_flowsheets/VAL_03_reference.json. Reference fields: Toluene stream T_K=373.15/P_Pa=200000 (feed T and P); HT-01 params T_out=873.15 (preheat); RX-01 params temperature_K=873.15/pressure_Pa=2350000/conversion=0.9002; CO-01 params T_out=353.15; HT-02 params T_out=375.15. Structural gaps: reference connections=[] (no topology data); hydrogen feed stream absent from reference (feed T/P/flow unknown); all molar flows null. Anomalous reference flow magnitudes (recycled vapour appears orders-of-magnitude larger than toluene feed — likely a normalisation artefact in the source DWSIM file). Mass balance does not close in reference. Distillation column V-03 modelled as Vessel type in reference (not Column); description says 'distillation column' to direct the model to use Column.

name: Hydrogen Production Biogas Reforming WGS PSA (fully-specified)
description: Construct the complete H2-REF hydrogen-production flowsheet from biogas, including the tail-gas combustion train. Feed 38.5 kg/h of biogas at 298.15 K and 1 bar with mole fractions 0.597 methane, 0.4006 carbon dioxide, 0.002 nitrogen, and 0.0004 oxygen. Compress the biogas to 16 bar and heat it to 1182.15 K. Feed 45.55 kg/h of liquid water at 298.15 K and 1 bar to a pump, raise it to 16 bar, and heat it separately to 1182.15 K. Mix the hot biogas and steam and send them to an equilibrium steam methane reformer at approximately 1181.8 K and 16 bar. Include steam methane reforming, CH4 + H2O <-> CO + 3H2, and water-gas shift, CO + H2O <-> CO2 + H2, with the reformer producing approximately 80% methane conversion. Cool the reformer syngas to 623.15 K and feed it to a high-temperature water-gas shift conversion reactor at 16 bar with 75% carbon monoxide conversion. Its outlet is approximately 740.98 K and 15.75 bar. Cool this stream to 483.15 K and feed it to a low-temperature water-gas shift conversion reactor at 15.7 bar with a further 75% carbon monoxide conversion. Its outlet is approximately 514.58 K. Cool the shifted gas to 311.15 K at 15.7 bar so that water condenses, then use a gas-liquid separator to remove the liquid water. Send the dry vapour to a pressure swing adsorption unit configured for 99.99% hydrogen purity and approximately 79% hydrogen recovery. Withdraw the hydrogen product at 311.15 K and 15.7 bar. Send the PSA tail gas through a pressure-reducing valve to 1 bar, mix it with 92.14 kg/h of air at 298.15 K and 1 bar, and heat the mixture to 523.15 K. Burn the residual methane, carbon monoxide, and hydrogen completely in a conversion reactor at 1 bar using CH4 + 2O2 -> CO2 + 2H2O, CO + 0.5O2 -> CO2, and H2 + 0.5O2 -> H2O. Cool the flue gas to 473.15 K before discharge. The complete process must retain both shift reactors, the condenser and water separator, the PSA unit, and the full tail-gas valve, air-mixing, preheating, combustion, and flue-gas cooling sequence.
notes: Fully-specified variant of VAL_04. Values read from benchmark/reference_flowsheets/VAL_04_reference.json. Reference fields: BIOGAS/WATER/AIR feed T_K=298.15/P_Pa=100000; S-01 T_K=589.818 (compressor outlet); S-05 T_K=1181.781/P_Pa=1600000 (reformer inlet); S-08 T_K=623.15 (HE-03 outlet); RC-02 outlet T_K=740.978/P_Pa=1575000; S-011 T_K=483.15 (HE-04 outlet); RC-03 outlet T_K=514.575/P_Pa=1570000; S-014 T_K=311.15/vapor_fraction=0.8311 (HE-05 outlet); H2 T_K=311.15/P_Pa=1570000; VALVE outlet T_K=296.153/P_Pa=100000; HE-06 outlet T_K=523.15; RC-04 outlet T_K=1550.034/P_Pa=100000; FLUE GAS T_K=473.15. Unit params absent from reference for all units (temperatures inferred from stream values only). RC-01 is equilibrium type; RC-02/RC-03/RC-04 conversion parameters absent from reference. Compounds extended to 7 (adds Nitrogen, Oxygen vs the 5-compound L1 VAL_04 case) to cover the combustion section. Molar flows all null in reference. 44 stream-level connection edges in reference simplified to unit-to-unit topology in reference_structure.
